description: Gets you an alert by webhook each time a ticker starts matching a screen. Webhooks need a paid plan (Free has no webhook slots). Use for "alert me when this happens" requests. For one signal use tickerbot_subscribe_signal; a compound condition is a scan: `q: golden_cross AND rsi_14 > 70`.

cadence.description: How often to evaluate: `realtime` (the default) is checked each time the data refreshes, about once a minute; `hourly` and `nyse_open` are checked on that schedule.

channel.description: Delivery channel: `webhook` (POST to `target_url`), `discord` (an embed at `discord_url`), `in_app` (the dashboard only) or `mobile_push` (to `device_id`). Inferred when omitted: `discord` if `discord_url` is set, else `mobile_push` if `device_id` is set, else `webhook` if `target_url` is set, else `in_app`. See Delivery channels.

device_id.description: Only with `channel=mobile_push`. Device to notify, from `POST /v2/devices/register`. An unknown id is a 400 `device_not_found`.

discord_url.description: Only with `channel=discord`. Discord incoming-webhook URL (`https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…`). Stored as a posting credential: the create response echoes it back under `channel_config`, but every later read (list, get, deliveries) strips it and sets `channel_config_present: true` instead.

name.description: Display name, up to 80 characters. Defaults to `scan: ` plus the first 60 characters of `q`.

order.description: Signal each delivery's match lists are sorted by before the 100-result cap applies, so a broad alert lists the same top 100 each time. Must be a real signal (validated at creation).

q.description: WHERE-clause expression using signal names: the same grammar and the same 4000-char cap as `POST /v2/scan`, so anything scannable is subscribable. Custom signals are expanded and frozen in at creation.

select.description: What each delivered match carries. Omitted: the scan default row (ticker, name, asset_class, asset_type, price, change_1d_pct, gap_pct, relative_volume, market_cap) plus every signal used in `q` and `order`. A list of signal names: exactly those, `ticker` always included. Each must be a real signal; unknown ones are rejected at creation. `*` and expressions are a 400: a delivery lists up to 100 matches, so name the signals.

target_url.description: Only with `channel=webhook`. HTTPS URL each delivery is POSTed to.

universe.description: Scope to a built-in universe (`top_10`, `top_100`) or one of your own, by id. An unknown one is a 400 `universe_not_found` naming it.

name: tickerbot_subscribe_scan
